cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set the kitchen timer like you. Another twenty minutes keeping dinner warm. I'm always the one waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I set mine for the phone to charge. The battery died; that's why I didn't call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, charging time. Last time it was the train. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven, whether you call or not.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll still be cooking and waiting. Miss another call and you can buy and cook your own dinner.
